$comment: SYNTHETIC test fixture - NEVER in data/. Exercises every code path: all five verdicts (fits, fits_via_proxy_probe, reject_no_probe, reject_guardrail, reject_multi_dimension), an event with no benign control (fx_guard), a null refusal_rate, at least one all-rejected cell in each coverage matrix, and a blank onset x duration cell (insidious x persisting). Unlike the seed data, appraisals here CARRY a verdict block so the adjudicated views can be tested. Run: python gate/build.py tests/fixture.json dist/gate1.fixture.html

events.label: Fixture - clean fit + proxy + benign
events.text: I was in a building when the floor gave way under one corner of the room. I held onto a rail for a few minutes until people pulled me clear.

appraisals.text: I could not do anything but hold on and wait for other people to reach me.

verdict.why: Helplessness carried by persistence under obstruction.

appraisals.text: When I try to lay out those minutes in order they come apart and I lose the sequence.

verdict.why: No bodily carrier, but narrative breakage is measurable on re-narration.

appraisals.text: It was frightening for a few minutes and then it was over and I was fine.

verdict.why: Matched benign control; refusal not yet measured.

events.label: Fixture - no-probe + multi-injury + benign
events.text: For a long stretch I slept badly and could not settle, and during the same period a relative kept promising help and never once arrived.

appraisals.text: Even now my heart races and I cannot settle when the room is too quiet.

verdict.why: Surfaces only as physiological arousal; no textual carrier.

appraisals.text: Nothing anyone tried made it better, and the person who kept promising to help never came through.

verdict.why: Carries helplessness AND a broken-trust injury; cannot be assigned to one cell.

appraisals.text: It was a rough patch of poor sleep and some unmet promises, but we got through it.

events.label: Fixture - guardrail event with NO benign control
events.text: I was attacked and badly hurt by a stranger one evening.

appraisals.text: There was nothing I could do to stop it.

verdict.why: Violent material trips a categorical refusal; recorded as a DV.

appraisals.text: It happened on a street I trusted, and the trust is what broke.

verdict.why: Same violent material; refusal recorded per event.

events_deferred.note: Present so the deferred panel renders in the fixture build.
